result_text:
The parent report no longer aborts when a sub-landscape's `config.json` is missing or unreadable. The fix is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in the Sub-landscapes row rendering (around lines 652–656).

The NPE came from `subLandscapeConfig.getMetadata()`, which dereferenced the `null` that `getSubLandscapeConfig` returns on a read failure. Now the code takes the logo link from the config only if the config and its metadata are both present. Otherwise the logo link is `null`, so the row takes the existing default-logo branch and still links to the sub-landscape's index page. Sub-landscapes with a config still show their own logo, and the other rows are unchanged.

The `reports` module compiles offline and its existing test (`ReportFileExporterTest`) passes. I did not add a test or run a full landscape generation against a folder with a missing `config.json`, so the end-to-end behaviour is verified by reading the code rather than by running it. Nothing is committed.
